items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame after QUESTIONABLE; confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: Calf; optimism from feeling better Saturday, no setbacks per sources
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if no limitations

items.text: ETR GTD/PESSIMISM on Breece Hall (quad); officially inactive after limited practice and early return attempt.
items.why: Quad strain; not full participant, unlikely per reports
items.implication: Misses 4th straight; committee or backup elevates
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps/carries expand in Jets backfield

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (high ankle sprain); Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle; limited practice, missed 3rd straight
items.implication: QB downgrade for Ravens stack; Flowers/Likely less upside
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players adjust roles

items.text: Jonah Coleman 1st game back led Broncos RB snaps 50%/rush 41%/routes 34%; JK Dobbins only 21% snaps. LOVE/upgrade; roster in 100%.
items.why: Post-return usage dominance; preseason call validated

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely available soon; monitor Vikings RB

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but not certain of severity; watching with Tracy.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; potential role loss if misses
items.opportunity: Backup RBs (Tracy etc) could see expanded carries if out

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine; would be tilting if hurt avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no indication of significant issue

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith/Wicks; Barkley expected after prior issues
items.implication: Eagles WR target vacuum; Barkley RB1 role locked if active
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining PHI pass-catchers; Barkley carries/RZ

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated and IN for Packers.
items.why: Activated from IR/injury; expected to play
items.implication: Reclaims lead RB role; Packers backfield clarity
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/RZ share as lead back

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome high-value touch RB: worst runner but fantasy RB13 PPR ppg via 9 carries inside 5 + 45 targets (leads RBs).
items.implication: Sustainable floor via opportunity despite YPC

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible in fantasy.
items.why: Big game explosion; trade value peak
items.implication: Capitalize on production spike before regression

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24 lead on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return (1st since 2024); Noel left early turf toe.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha WR; Dell slow ramp

items.text: Seahawks/Broncos/Vikings/Packers potential JT suitors pre-deadline; Jadarian Price (chest) eligible Week 8 return, window open if SEA needs weapons beyond JSN.
items.why: Schefter trade names + Price practice window opening
items.implication: JT trade value/ROS if moved; Price stash if SEA adds
items.opportunity: Price return could create committee or change SEA RB

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); has never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.why: Rice out hamstring; Worthy clear route leader
items.implication: Volume opportunity but historical ceiling caps upside
items.opportunity: High route share/targets in Chiefs offense
items.conflict: High volume vs low historical production ceiling
